records.subject: Picking back up with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Zara,

Checking back in on Bright Group -- if there's a reason setup hasn't happened yet, I'd like to understand it so we can fix it.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.subject: Re: How's the first week going?
records.body:
Hi Chidi,

All good here, thanks! Might take you up on a walkthrough call at some point.

Zara

records.subject: How's the first week going?
records.body:
Hi Zara,

Just checking in a few days after you signed up -- how's it going so far? Happy to jump on and help with anything that's unclear.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Bright Group!
records.body:
Hi Zara,

Your Wrenfield account is live. A simple way to start: one project, a handful of real tasks, then an invite to a teammate. No need to overthink the setup.

Here if you need anything.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: Zara replied warmly but vaguely ("All good here", "at some point") in email:551d8e30 with zero product progress by day 6 — no project, no invite, no tickets. Engagement is with email, not the product; two nudges (email:b6a41447, email:ba36d3a2) produced no action, so unaided activation in 8 days is possible but unlikely.

draft.subject: Re: How's the first week going?
draft.body:
Hi Zara,

Glad to hear the first week has gone smoothly, and I'd be happy to do that walkthrough whenever it suits you — would a short call this week work?

If it's useful before then, projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so one real project is usually the easiest place to start. A teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Just say the word and I'll help with whichever step is most useful.

Best,
Chidi
